title: Power Rangers Season 5 Turbo
description: Divatox has begun her invasion on Earth and the Power Rangers trade in their Zeo crystal powers for Turbo technology powers to combat this new threat.

episodes.title: S5-E34The Turn of the Wretched Wrench

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x1
episodes_data.description: Divatox returns to Earth seeking vengeance against the Power Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x2
episodes_data.description: With Justin busy fighting Elgar, Divatox attacks Tanya, Adam, and Katherine. Meanwhile, Zordon and Alpha are keeping a secret from the Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x3
episodes_data.description: The results of Justin's test are in, and as it turns out, he's going to be starting high school due to being a genius. Zordon reveals that he and Alpha are returning to Eltar with Lerigot. Divatox begins trying to close the wormhole that is taking Zordon and Alpha home.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x4
episodes_data.description: Divatox sends the evil Chromite monster to Angel Grove with a detonator. When the Rangers try to stop him, he steals their morphing powers to create the Shadow Rangers. Tommy is forced to find a way to stop Chromite and track down his missing friends by himself.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x5
episodes_data.description: Visceron travels from the planet Inquiris to deliver some startling news to Dimitria. Divatox learns of this and captures him. She then turns him against the Rangers when he refuses to tell her his message.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x6
episodes_data.description: Trying to impress his aunt Divatox, Elgar decides to sabotage Justin's box car race with a detonator he made himself. Meanwhile, Porto goes AWOL and attacks the city.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x7
episodes_data.description: Some of Adam's friends decide to settle an argument by drag racing. Divatox's Demon Racer plants a detonator in one of their cars. The Rangers have to defeat the Demon Racer and stop the detonator before it blows.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x8
episodes_data.description: It's Justin's birthday and Divatox has sent him a gift. The Rangers have to get Justin off his new bike before it explodes in 25 miles. If that was not bad enough, Divatox sends Big Burpa to distract them.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x9
episodes_data.description: During a volunteer car wash, Porto appears and plants a detonator. Justin spots him and the Mouthpiece monster attacks him and makes it so he can only tell lies. Meanwhile, Porto has made it so anytime one of the Rangers lie, a Pirahantron attacks.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x10
episodes_data.description: Divatox summons her ancient Egyptian ex-fiance Pharaoh to battle the Turbo Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x11
episodes_data.description: Due to an insult from a rival ballet dancer, Kat is worried over her weight. Divatox sends Numbor to attack the Rangers, rendering Kat weightless.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x12
episodes_data.description: Divatox plants a detonator on a firetruck and has her Pirahantrons set off fire alarms all over the city. Meanwhile, Justin has his own problems with some bullies from school, and he almost gets caught teleporting.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x13
episodes_data.description: The Blue Senturion, an intergalactic law enforcement robot, arrives from the year 2000 with a message for Dimitria; Lord Zedd, Rita, The Machine Empire and Divatox will team up to destroy the universe. When Divatox learns of this message, she reprograms the Blue Senturion to think the Rangers are evil.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x14
episodes_data.description:
Divatox plants a detonator in the scoreboard at one of Adam's soccer games. If Angel Grove scores 4 points, it will go off. She sends Electrovolt to distract the Rangers.

First appearance of Ashley and Carlos.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x15
episodes_data.description: Lt. Stone's niece, Jenny, competes with Kat to get into London's Royal Dance Academy. Divatox decides to plant a detonator at the competition, disguised as a cassette player, and sends Wolfgang Amadeus Griller to distract the Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x16
episodes_data.description: Divatox sends Shrinkasect to mess with the Blue Senturion's hardware. The Shrinkasect monster shrinks the Rangers while Justin is trying to stop Bulk and Skulls car.

episodes_data.title: https://vidxstream.xyz/v/nocwRunxdNgK/Power Rangers Turbo 5x17
episodes_data.description: The Rangers attempt to break out of Divatox's submarine. Meanwhile, Justin tries to unshrink the Blue Senturion and find the detonator that Bulk and Skull have mistakenly taken.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x18
episodes_data.description: The Rangers prepare for their final assignment while Divatox decides to capture Tommy.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x19
episodes_data.description: Tommy, Kat, Adam, and Tanya pass their powers on to a new generation of Power Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x20
episodes_data.description: Divatox uses Ashley's fashion jacket to control the minds of the citizens of Angel Grove as well as the Blue Senturion.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x21
episodes_data.description: Two intelligent cars from outer space called Lightning Cruiser and Storm Blaster travel to Earth.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x22
episodes_data.description: Divatox is struck by amnesia while the Power Rangers battle evil pizzas.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x23
episodes_data.description: The mysterious Phantom Ranger appears on Earth to assist the Power Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x24
episodes_data.description: The Rangers try to uncover why everything around them is disappearing including the Power Chamber.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x25
episodes_data.description: Divatox attempts to control time in order to freeze the planet Earth.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x26
episodes_data.description: General Havoc reinforces Divatox helping her capture the Turbo Megazord.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x27
episodes_data.description: With no way to defend Angel Grove, the Rangers turn to the Phantom Ranger for assistance.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x28
episodes_data.description: General Havoc and Divatox set a trap for the Phantom Ranger in order to capture his powerful Phantom Ruby.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x29
episodes_data.description: The Turbo Rangers race to stop the Turbo Megazord and save the Phantom Ranger as his life force ebbs away.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x30
episodes_data.description: Justin suspects that his fellow Rangers have been replaced by robots.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x31
episodes_data.description: The Wicked Wisher grants Divatox three wishes. One of which she uses to turn the Blue Senturion evil.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x32
episodes_data.description: The Power Rangers hurry to find the third wishing coin and restore the Blue Senturion.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x33
episodes_data.description: The Torch Tiger steals the Turbo Rangers' super fuel turning him into an arsonist nightmare.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x34
episodes_data.description: Ashley finds her auto mechanics class more difficult than she anticipated which is further complicated by her fellow student, the Maniac Mechanic.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x35
episodes_data.description: T.J. meets a mysterious young boy in the forest named Erutan.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x36
episodes_data.description: Cassie's new rock band turns out to be more than she bargained for.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x37
episodes_data.description: When Carlos injures a rival, even he isn't sure if it was really by accident.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x38
episodes_data.description: As Elgar repairs his Zord, Cassie loses her dog Jetson, but meets a mysterious new friend who knows her better than anyone.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x39
episodes_data.description: T.J. needs to learn how to hit a curve ball if he's going to save his baseball team's chances of victory as well as the world.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x40
episodes_data.description: An encounter with a mutated lunar bat leaves Carlos with an aversion to sunlight, and a powerful thirst - for blood!

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x41
episodes_data.description: Justin is given superhuman strength when a radioactive ant bites him. Meanwhile, Divatox pilots the first of her Divazords into battle against the Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x42
episodes_data.description: Cassie and Ashley compete for the new kid in school's affections while Porto pilots the Shark Zord into battle.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x43
episodes_data.description: T.J. tries to help Bulk and Skull find out who is raiding Angel Grove for spare parts.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x44
episodes_data.description: Justin faces the possibility of having to move away as against overwhelming odds, the Turbo Rangers charge into their final battle.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Turbo 5x45
episodes_data.description: The remaining Power Rangers blast off into outer space to try and save Zordon.
